aiOverview.content: The Artemis II mission launches from Kennedy Space Center (KSC) in Florida, with live, official coverage available on NASA+ (app/website), NASA’s YouTube channel, and Prime Video. Live broadcasts also appear on major news networks like CBS and YouTube channels like Spaceflight Now. NASA+ (app/website) NASA’s YouTube channel Prime Video Spaceflight Now Where to Watch Live Coverage (Online/TV): NASA+ & YouTube: Official launch commentary, live views from mission control, and in-space views. NASA+ & YouTube CBS News/Paramount+: Special reports with expert coverage. CBS News/Paramount+ Prime Video: NASA's FAST channel offers live, free coverage. Prime Video In-Person Viewing Locations (Florida Space Coast): Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex: Offers official, ticketed viewing locations like the LC-39 Observation Gantry or Saturn V Center. Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex LC-39 Observation Gantry Saturn V Center Space View Park: Located in Titusville, providing public access and direct views across the water. Space View Park Other Public Spots: Beaches and parks in Titusville, Cocoa Beach, and Cape Canaveral.
